caseName: Director, Office of Workers' Compensation Programs v. Kyle
caseNameFull: Director, Office of Workers' Compensation Programs, United States Department of Labor v. Kyle and National Council on Compensation Insurance v. Kyle

opinions.text: 488 U. S. 997. Motion of respondent Fred Kyle for attorney’s fees granted, and the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit is directed to determine the fee to be allowed for the work performed by counsel before this Court.
